newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Chemiphar sees higher sales due to new drug.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Chemiphar sees higher sales due to new drug.

text.p: Japan pharmaceuticals maker Nippon Chemiphar Co Ltd said on Wednesday that it aims to boost its parent sales to more than 30 billion yen in the year to March 31, 2001, from 21.25 billion yen in 1995/96.
The sales increase would be due to the expected introduction of a new drug for ulcers that was exclusively developed by Nippon Chemiphar, a company spokesman said.
The company has already applied to the Ministry of Health and Welfare for approval to sell the drug in Japan, he said.
The company does not know the result of its application, but hopes to start selling the drug in the 1997/98 business year, the spokesman said.
